lead.t: Ambulatory blood pressure monitoring (ABPM) over 24 hr, the gold standard of blood pressure evaluation, is recommended in patients with renal disease to diagnose and treat hypertension, especially masked hypertension.

snip.t: Ambulatory blood pressure monitoring (ABPM) over 24 hr, the gold standard of blood pressure evaluation, is recommended in patients with renal disease to diagnose and treat hypertension, especially masked hypertension.

qs.q: Why is ambulatory blood pressure monitoring (ABPM) particularly important in pediatric predialysis CKD patients?
o: It directly diagnoses dangerous electrolyte imbalances
It identifies masked hypertension carrying left ventricular risks
It represents the only way to measure glomerular filtration
It is much simpler and cheaper than office measurements
qs.e: ABPM is recommended because it can detect masked hypertension (normal office BP but abnormal ABPM), which is seen in up to 35% of these patients and increases the risk of LVH four-fold. ABPM is for BP evaluation, not GFR measurement or direct diagnosis of electrolyte imbalances.

qs.q: What is the purpose of ambulatory blood pressure monitoring over 24 hours?
o: Assess blood pressure variability and accuracy
qs.e: ** Ambulatory blood pressure monitoring measures blood pressure at regular intervals over 24 hours to assess variability, accuracy, and patterns throughout day and night.
